descriptions.sales: What sold in this period. Undone sales are negative and may be from earlier sales.
descriptions.games: Sold = scanned + manual + stocktake backfill; sorted by game code. Margin = gross profit ÷ net sales.
descriptions.profit: The price difference earned on the tickets sold, using each ticket's cost when it was sold.
descriptions.redemption: Redemptions recorded in this period, by their status at the end of the period. Valid = held in store + sent for claim.
descriptions.inventory: Add and subtract from top to bottom; the check row should be 0.
descriptions.inventoryInfo: Not part of the calculation above; listed for reference.
descriptions.cashDifference: + means more cash than expected, − means less. A post-close correction explains a closed shift: its real difference = checkout difference − correction.
descriptions.cashMovement: + is money in, − is money out, for the drawer and the vault.
descriptions.bank: Accounts this store uses, counting only this store's transactions; in is positive, out is negative.
descriptions.outstanding: What was still owed at the end of the period (balances, not activity).
descriptions.notes: Things to look at that are not amounts.
descriptions.compare: Key figures of each branch side by side; the total matches the all-branches sheet.
descriptions.estimated: This period has ticket numbers assigned by the system: game totals are exact; per-book sales, cost of sales, gross profit and ending stock cost are estimates.
descriptions.gamesCount: Sold = scanned + marked manually + marked by count + stocktake backfill; sorted by game code. Margin = gross profit ÷ net sales.

footnotes.cashMovement: 5b is not a full cash book: cash from sales is in 1 Sales and prize payouts in 3 Prize redemption. See the live cash book in Accounts for the expected drawer and vault amounts.
footnotes.bank: Each type is one row, reversals included. Ending balance = opening balance + all transactions up to the end, including other branches.
